moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio e-steps, written here): Target moves 0 → 100 % in 6 equal holds, 500 ms (steps(6)): a stop-motion or dropped-frame feel. Note: the site's demo levels are 0, 0.2 … 1 (reaching 1 at 5/6 of the time); GSAP steps(6) gives 0 … 5/6, then 1 at the end. Site demo: 1200 ms across 114 px beside the curve graph and a 12-frame spacing ruler (guides, not ported). Params: duration (0.5 s) · steps (6).
